## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// An idealized rope over two pulleys: lengthA + Ratio * lengthB stays
// constant, where lengthA runs from GroundAnchorA (world space) to AnchorA
// and lengthB from GroundAnchorB to AnchorB. Ratio is dimensionless.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pulley)
type PulleyJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    GroundAnchorA: Point3D;
    GroundAnchorB: Point3D;
    AnchorA: Point3D;
    AnchorB: Point3D;
    Ratio: Number;
}

// A configurable six-degree-of-freedom joint: each translational axis of the
// joint frames carries a linear limit (meters) and each rotational axis an
// angular limit. FrameA and FrameB are the joint frames in each body's local
// frame.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Degrees_of_freedom_(mechanics))
type GenericJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    FrameA: Pose3D;
    FrameB: Pose3D;
    LinearX: LinearLimit;
    LinearY: LinearLimit;
    LinearZ: LinearLimit;
    AngularX: AngularLimit;
    AngularY: AngularLimit;
    AngularZ: AngularLimit;
}

// A velocity coupling between two rotational axes (gear train): body B's
// angular velocity about AxisB is -Ratio times body A's about AxisA. Ratio is
// the dimensionless gear ratio; the axes are in each body's local frame.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gear_train)
type GearConstraint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AxisA: Direction3D;
    AxisB: Direction3D;
    Ratio: Number;
}

//==
// # Joint groupings

// A reusable articulated-figure wiring: the joints connecting a ragdoll's
// limbs. Body indices inside the joints refer to the ragdoll's own body
// array; BreakThresholds, when non-empty, applies one threshold per joint in
// declaration order (hinges first, then ball-sockets, then fixed).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ragdoll_physics)
type RagdollProfile
    implements IValue
{
    HingeJoints: Array<HingeJoint>;
    BallSocketJoints: Array<BallSocketJoint>;
    FixedJoints: Array<FixedJoint>;
    BreakThresholds: Array<JointBreakThreshold>;
}

//==
// # Joint limits and motors
//
// The shared parameter blocks a joint is configured with: the allowed range
// of relative motion, the drive that pushes toward a target velocity, and the
// load at which the joint breaks. Linear quantities are in meters and
// seconds, angular quantities in radians and seconds.

// An inclusive allowed range of relative rotation. When Enabled is false the
// rotation is unbounded.
type AngularLimit
    implements IValue
{
    Min: Angle;
    Max: Angle;
    Enabled: Boolean;
}

// An inclusive allowed range of relative translation along a joint's axis,
// in meters. When Enabled is false the translation is unbounded.
type LinearLimit
    implements IValue
{
    Min: Number;
    Max: Number;
    Enabled: Boolean;
}

// A drive that pushes a joint toward a target relative velocity.
// TargetVelocity is in meters per second for linear axes and radians per
// second for angular axes; MaxForce and MaxTorque cap what the drive may
// exert.
type JointMotor
    implements IValue
{
    TargetVelocity: Number;
    MaxForce: Force;
    MaxTorque: Torque;
    Enabled: Boolean;
}

// The load at which a joint breaks and is removed from the simulation: it
// breaks when the constraint force exceeds MaxForce or the constraint torque
// exceeds MaxTorque.
type JointBreakThreshold
    implements IValue
{
    MaxForce: Force;
    MaxTorque: Torque;
}
```
